profile_text.body:
Atlassian is a publicly traded Australian software company, founded in 2002 and headquartered in Sydney, that makes collaboration tools for software, IT, and business teams. Its site describes a platform spanning products including Jira, Confluence, Trello, Loom, and Rovo, positioned for project planning, team wikis, meeting recordings, and shared work management. The company describes its offerings as designed to support evolving standards and regulatory requirements.

Atlassian has integrated AI features into several of its products. Confluence AI adds smart links and automation to its team wiki product, and Trello AI brings workflow automation to its project management tool, both operating under Atlassian Cloud governance. The company frames its broader platform as enabling teams and AI agents to plan, execute, and deliver work together.

Atlassian is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001650372 and trades on a public exchange under the ticker TEAM. Its most recent annual filing, a 10-K for the period ending June 30, 2025, reported revenue of $5,215,304,000. No litigation or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts.
